name: planar ally
lore:
# On the Invocation of the Planar Ally

To weave the *Planar Ally* is to feel the fabric of existence tighten like a harp string tuned to the breaking point. The caster experiences a resonant thrum in the marrow of their bones, a sensation of pulling a heavy silken curtain across the stars. As the Weave yields, the air grows dense, perfumed with the scent of ozone and ancient incense.

Visually, the magic manifests as a "luminous wound"—a jagged fracture in the firmament through which the blinding radiance of the Celestial Mounts or the sulfurous haze of the Abyss bleeds. It is no mere portal, but a bridge of shimmering geometric light that anchors an entity of pure essence to our mundane soil.

Scholars trace this art to the *Pact of the Glass Spire*. Legend tells of Arch-Hierophant Vaelen, who, facing annihilation, offered his own heartbeat as collateral to summon a Solar. He proved that this spell is not a command, but a desperate negotiation with the infinite. 

Approach with humility, traveler; when one calls across the Great Void, the cosmos always keeps a ledger of the debt.
